title: Member-Paid Charges on Cardinal Roadside Assistance Service Calls
content:
## Rule

Under Cardinal Roadside Assistance the member pays the provider directly for:

- tow miles beyond the tow miles the option covers, at $4.25 per mile;
- the fuel itself;
- batteries, parts and keys;
- locksmith costs above the option's locksmith limit;
- every service after the allowance of covered service calls is used.

The member-paid part of each dispatch is recorded once, with its reason.

## Over-mileage rate by option

| Option | Rate the member pays the provider per tow mile beyond the covered distance |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic | $4.25 |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard | $4.25 |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus | $4.25 |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | $4.25 |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier | $4.25 |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | $4.25 |

## How the over-mileage amount is worked

The over-mileage amount is the miles towed less the tow miles the option covers, never less than zero, multiplied by the rate of $4.25 per mile. A tow within the covered miles leaves no over-mileage amount.

Worked examples on hypothetical tows (the covered miles are those of the option named):

| Option and covered tow miles | Miles towed | Miles beyond the covered distance | Member pays the provider |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic, 15 miles covered | 22 | 7 | 7 miles at $4.25, which is $29.75 |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard, 25 miles covered | 40 | 15 | 15 miles at $4.25, which is $63.75 |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus, 50 miles covered | 50 | 0 | Nothing for mileage |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier, 100 miles covered | 30 | 0 (the result does not go below zero) | Nothing for mileage |

## Other member-paid items, by reason

| Reason the member pays | What the member pays the provider for |
|---|---|
| Fuel | The fuel delivered |
| Battery, parts, keys | The battery, the parts or the keys themselves |
| Locksmith above the limit | The part of the locksmith cost above the option's locksmith limit |
| Allowance used | Every service once the allowance of covered calls is used |

Hypothetical locksmith case: on an option with a $75.00 locksmith limit, a locksmith bill of $110.00 leaves $35.00 for the member to pay the provider.

## Recording

Each dispatch with a member-paid part has that part recorded once, with the reason the member pays.
